notes.title: Infinite Adventures 1.10 Update! Wild Portal Configuration!
notes.notes:
Infinite Adventures 1.10 is live! With it comes the ability to customize Wild Portals (procedural dungeon levels) plus bug fixes and quality of life features like Autosaving.

New Features

 Wild Portal configuration screen (procedural dungeon levels)
 Customize dungeon size : Small 16x16, Medium 24x24, Large 32x32
 Customize boss : “Random” or “Choose” the exact boss you want to face. This should help people looking to farm for certain materials. Bosses will not appear in the “Choose” list until you have defeated them at least once.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32331111/292564e30161f12536948237c45f5ff4fcc8abff.png

 Autosave : The game now autosaves whenever you leave town or exit a dungeon level. There is only one autosave slot that gets overwritten as you play the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32331111/1d072476324345ac1ac7bebc98ae305eddb9ec6d.png

 Preview Skills : You can now click on a skill that you don't have to see the exact effect of that skill and how it progresses as that skill levels up. This should help when deciding what skills to learn and how to build your characters.
 Immune messages : When an enemy is immune to a status effect, the game will now show a message to let you know.


Balance Changes

 Shi Lorath's magic power adjusted so he won't be overpowered when using “Aeolopile”


Bug Fixes

 “Set Spear vs Charge” infinite triggers against enemies using “Heavenly Swords”
 Exploration Skills not resetting when creating a new game
 Skill previews missing cost reductions
 Skill previews missing gambit trigger rates
 Silence not working on spells only used by enemies
 Icon for Stormseeker main weapon not showing up in the view adventurer list
 Number of upgrade tokens required doesn't update immediately after upgrading a character
 Unreachable areas in floors 16, 23 and 24

notes.title: 1.09 patch is live!
notes.notes:
New Features
- "Sell All Materials" command in the store allowing you to sell all materials in your possession at once
- "Restore Formation" command in the exploration menu that restores your formation to the last formation you chose
- "Exp Penalty On/Off" option in the game options menu that will allow you to disable the exp penalty from to high levels, currently this option does NOT save, so you will have to turn it off anytime you restart the game

Balance Changes
- Stormseeker Astral Cap raised from 150 to 250

Bug Fixes
- Lady Luck now properly awards 2 runes when a rune is gathered alongside an ore
- Circle of Light and Circle of Darkness now show correct mana amounts when targeting enemies
- Achievements now do a check whenever you view the guild screen, which should help with progression achievements that may not have submitted properly

notes.title: Release Date 10/30/18!
notes.notes:
Prepare to enter the Infinite Dungeon . . . 

We are excited to announce that Infinite Adventures will be released on 10/30! 

Thanks everyone who has followed the game. We will be releasing new trailers over the next few weeks to do a deep dive into the story, combat, character creation, and skill progression systems.

If you have any questions about the game feel free to ask them in our Steam discussion forum and we will answer them.

With 24 levels in the main story, 25 bosses, 10 post game super bosses, 56 side quests, 10 character classes, 262 skills to learn, 24 summons to acquire, and a 100% voice acted script with over 40,000 words of dialogue, and the ability to explore an infinite number of procedural dungeon levels. Infinite Adventures is an Indie Game that has a ton of content.
